steel-39-mill-scale-landfill.rationale: Exact3.9cutoff steel-residue market reconstruction. Preserve original signed source demands and every freight row with original lognormal uncertainty, without transport distance, payload, moisture or mass scaling. Generic rail uses complete RER rail, barge uses complete RER inland barge, and unspecified road uses the complete RER heavy-lorry fleet: no air-freight or single-truck substitution. Geography, country/fuel/fleet mixtures, vintage, allocation and native internal uncertainty differ; score equivalence is not established. Preserve caller signs, formulas and supported uncertainty; no reverse, consequential or other-release approval is added. Mill scale uses its own68direct leachate releases in their exact ecoinvent3.10 species, units and receiving compartments, including long-term groundwater. Preserve stabilization cement0.4kg, all three regional operating rows, facility2.08333333333333e-9units and all three hydrated-cement disposal rows, with original uncertainty. Existing independently reviewed complete Swiss residual-landfill operation,300000m3facility, unspecified cement and dedicated hydrated-cement disposal are background proxies. Preserve original quantities and geographic weights without renormalization; geographic mix is represented by Swiss suppliers and their operation/energy/construction assumptions. Negative inputs to negative waste-treatment references are disposal demand and become positive service inputs; never substitute lead-smelter slag or invent material recovery. Native0%-water cement-disposal label does not establish source moisture equivalence. The two Strontium labels normalize to Strontium II using identical published flow UUIDs, units and compartments; quantities do not change. No source leachate flow is omitted or replaced by generic metal labels; no extra operating, construction or leachate burden is added. The source market reference is-1kg, so the positive-service helper uses factor-1.
